description: Ministry of Health - 10th Amendment, Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute, which governs the service conditions, promotions, and qualifications for nursing professionals in the public sector. The content specifically deals with public service recruitment regulations, promotion criteria, and service conditions for government nurses, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it references government bodies (Public Service Commission, Ministry of Health), the core content focuses on public sector employment rules rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
